Plugin.Name: Docker Template Fields
Plugin.Overview: Drag to reorder the fields of a Docker template, and switch a field off without deleting it. Adds a drag handle and an on/off switch to every Path, Port, Variable, Label and Device row on the Add/Edit Container page, including when installing an app from Community Apps. A disabled field stays in the template with its value but is left out of the container, which makes testing much easier.
